messages.text: Q2 FY26 numbers are in sales/sales_q2_2026.md. GMV up 18% QoQ, AOV ₹1,320. Apparel is still our top category.
Cart abandonment ticked up to 68% in June — mostly at the payment step. Purchase team is looking at it.
Reminder: 'sales' numbers = GMV before refunds. Net revenue subtracts the refund rate (2.1% in Q2). Don't mix the two in a deck.
Dashboards are owned by Data & Analytics (#team-data). If you need a new metric, open a request here, not a ticket on payments.
SUMMER20 promo drove a 24% order spike the first weekend but pulled AOV down — expected for a percentage-off coupon.
